headers.value: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

ignoreCommand: P=${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}; git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$P" HEAD -- .
